Charity Number: 20015183 THE SOLEMNITY OF OUR LORD JESUS CHRIST, KING OF THE UNIVERSE — CHRIST THE KING The Feast of Christ the King is celebrated on the last Sunday of the Church’s liturgical year, the 34th Sunday in Ordinary Time. On this day, we honour Jesus, as King of heaven & earth, whose kingdom is founded on truth, love, justice, mercy & peace. Jesus does not rule through force or power but through His love, truth & care for others. We are reminded to let Jesus guide our hearts & lives. Established by Pope Pius XI in 1925, this feast brings the Church community together to honour Christ & reflect on His place in our lives. FIRST SUNDAY OF ADVENT — 29th NOVEMBER Next Sunday, 29th November, marks the First Sunday of Advent & the beginning of a new liturgical year. Advent is a time of hope, prayer & preparation as we look forward to celebrating the birth of Jesus at Christmas. May the coming weeks offer us an opportunity to slow down, reflect & prepare our hearts for the coming of Christ. Many have stated putting up Christmas decorations these days, & certainly in the next few weeks. We strongly encourage including a Christmas Crib in your home . The Crib keeps Christ & the Holy Family at the heart of Christmas. ST. MARY’S ATHENRY CHRISTMAS MASS BOUQUET CARDS Athenry Christmas Mass Bouquets are now available in the Parish Office.
